meta_description: M. Collett Painters & Decorators in Liverpool. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and preparation work. Free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painters & Decorators — Liverpool & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to complete exterior repaints, M. Collett delivers quality finishes on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Liverpool
services_subhead: We handle everything from single-room refreshes to full house redecorations, with meticulous preparation and premium finishes.

services.title: Interior Decorating
services.desc: Wall and ceiling painting, feature walls, and colour consultation. We prep every surface properly so your new look lasts years, not months.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for fascias, soffits, doors, and brickwork. We use quality paints rated for Liverpool's climate.

services.title: Surface Preparation
services.desc: Filling, sanding, and repair of plaster, drywall, and timber before painting. Poor prep is the enemy of a good finish — we never cut corners.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wallcoverings
services.desc: Expert hanging of traditional wallpaper, feature papers, and modern wall coverings. Pattern matching and seamless application included.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Painting and staining of doors, skirting boards, architrave, and built-in furniture. We sand, undercoat, and finish to a professional standard.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and rental properties refreshed quickly and cleanly. We work around your schedule to minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: Every job done right, first time. No shortcuts, no rush, just honest work.
about_para_1: M. Collett Painters & Decorators has been serving Liverpool and Bootle for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that decoration shouldn't be stressful, we've built a reputation for turning tired rooms into homes people love. Mark and the team pride themselves on showing up on time, respecting your property, and leaving it cleaner than they found it.
about_para_2: We don't use high-pressure sales tactics or hidden charges. A free quote means a free quote — no obligation, no follow-up calls. Hundreds of homeowners and landlords across Liverpool come back to us because we listen, deliver what we promise, and stand behind our work with a professional finish that lasts.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About M. Collett

reviews.text: Couldn't fault them. Mark came round, measured up, gave us a price on the spot. Three weeks later the whole house was redecorated. Walls are immaculate, no mess left behind. Will definitely have them back for the bedrooms next year.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: We've had two large projects done now. They're reliable, they turn up when they say they will, and the quality is genuinely excellent. Not the cheapest but you get what you pay for. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer T.

reviews.text: Had our hallway and stairs done. The preparation work was thorough — filled all the cracks, sanded everything down properly. Paint finish is smooth and even. Professional team, fair pricing. Top job.
reviews.author: Robert M.
